item.title: WordPress Plugin Update
item.description:
250-750 CAD | I need an experienced WordPress developer to update all plugins on my site.
Requirements: - Update all existing plugins - Ensure site functionality post-update - No customizations needed, just the updates

item.title: Quick Domain Migration To Cloudflare
item.description:
30-250 USD | My small brochure-style site is online now and the domain expires this December. I’ve decided to move the registration to Cloudflare because my current registrar, “Domain Name Services,” is charging far more than it’s worth.
What I need from you • Unlock the domain at the current registrar, generate the transfer code and complete the move to Cloudflare. • Reproduce whatever DNS records are in place today so the site keeps working without noticeable downtime. I’m honestly not sure whether there are any custom records, but there is no email or other fancy service hanging off the domain. (Or if it has an email I don't use it.) • Once the nameservers flip, confirm the site resolves correctly worldwide.
Possible extras I’m undecided about Cloudflare-specific features such as SSL or DDoS protection. If you spot an easy win while you’re inside the dashboard, flag it and we can decide on the spot.
Success looks like this: the domain shows up as active in my Cloudflare account, the website loads exactly as it does now, and I can relax before renewal time rolls around. This should be a quick project for anyone who lives in the Cloudflare interface every day.

item.title: Enhance Shopify Store - Photo Editing & Descriptions
item.description:
30-250 USD | Shopify Product Page Updates & Simple Photo Editing
I’m looking for a freelancer to update the product images and descriptions on my clothing brand’s Shopify website.
The work includes:
Replace main product images that don’t show a model. Only change the front image for products currently showing the clothing without a model. Replace these with photos of the clothing worn by models, choosing the most appealing picture that clearly shows the clothing and looks good within the website layout. Leave existing front images featuring models unchanged.
Make the backgrounds consistent. All replacement front images should match the light grey background of our existing images, with consistent cropping and sizing.
Lightly edit any unedited replacement photos. This includes very subtle, natural skin smoothing, slight waist slimming, and smoothing distracting wrinkles in the clothing. The edits should look natural and unnoticeable, keeping the clothing’s details and colors accurate.
Review and improve every product description. Make sure each description reads well and includes enough information about the style, fit, fabric, and relevant details, using the product information we provide.
Please share examples of your Shopify work and photo editing, along with your rate and estimated completion time.

item.title: WIX to Shopify Migration
item.description:

Additionally, I require custom design and branding elements to be integrated.
Ideal skills and experience: - Proficiency in both WIX and Shopify - Strong understanding of e-commerce site functionality - Experience in custom design and branding on Shopify - Ability to ensure a seamless transition with no downtime
Please provide examples of similar work done.

item.title: Duplicate My Wix Website

item.title: Klaviyo Setup for Fashion Store
item.description:
30-250 USD | I need our entire clothing-brand email programme moved into Klaviyo this week. The job covers:
• Migrating existing subscriber data from our current platform • Connecting Klaviyo to our Shopify store and verifying all tracking events fire correctly • Building and activating every standard Klaviyo flow—Welcome Series, Abandoned Cart, Post-Purchase Follow-up, plus any other built-in flows the platform offers • Creating simple, on-brand templates for each flow (logo, colours, editable text blocks only; full design work will come later) • Adding a site-wide pop-up that offers free shipping when someone subscribes, set to appear on first visit and again at checkout, with the code delivered automatically after confirmation • Running end-to-end tests so each trigger, email, discount and analytic report works without errors
When you reply, please include: – A brief note on your Klaviyo + Shopify experience – Two or three examples of similar migrations you’ve completed – Your fixed project rate – Confirmation you can deliver everything within one week
I’ll be available for quick feedback and can provide store access as soon as we agree on terms.

item.title: Web-based Serialized Fiction Platform
item.description:
3000-5000 USD | I'm looking to create a web platform for serialized fiction reading.
Key Requirements: - User registration/login: Secure accounts for personalized experiences. - Bookmarking chapters: Allow users to save their reading progress. - Comment section: Enable discussions and interactions on chapters.
Ideal Skills and Experience: - Web development expertise (front-end and back-end) - Experience in building user authentication systems - Familiarity with creating interactive comment sections

item.title: Minimalist Website Redesign
item.description:
250-750 USD | Our current site functions well, yet it looks dated. I need a full visual overhaul that keeps the existing content and back-end untouched while giving every page a clean, contemporary, minimalist appearance that feels effortless on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
What I expect • A cohesive style system—typography, color palette, spacing, icons, micro-interactions—documented and supplied alongside high-fidelity mock-ups (Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD are all fine). • Responsive front-end build in lightweight HTML, CSS, and optional vanilla JavaScript or a utility framework such as Tailwind; nothing heavy that would slow the site. • Roughly a dozen public-facing pages re-skinned, with components modular enough for my in-house developer to drop straight into our existing codebase.
Acceptance criteria 1. Mock-ups signed off by me before coding begins. 2. Final pages score 90 + on Google PageSpeed (mobile and desktop). 3. Delivered assets match approved designs pixel-for-pixel across modern browsers.
To apply, point me to at least three live projects or case studies that show your ability to execute a minimalist aesthetic—links only, no big write-up needed. If your portfolio includes sites resembling Apple, Dropbox, or similar uncluttered brands, even better.
Initial design concepts within one week of hire; full delivery within 3 weeks
current website greatwesternprinting.com
Thanks for taking the time to look at my bid

item.title: Redesign for Dog Grooming Website
item.description:
250-750 GBP | My site www.pawperfectdoggrooming.com is ready for a complete makeover. The current pages feel tired and old-fashioned, the search rankings have slipped, and the responsive view no longer behaves the way it should.
The most urgent task is a fresh design and layout. I want an elegant, sophisticated look that instantly conveys quality mobile grooming, with a refined colour palette and striking imagery that shows off happy, well-styled dogs. Keep the typography simple and readable, but please make the colours and photos shine.
Once the new design is in place, I also need the underlying theme coded so it renders flawlessly on both mobile and desktop. While you’re under the hood, a light SEO tune-up—clean meta tags, proper headings, faster load times—will help the new look perform as well as it appears.
Key deliverables • Elegant, responsive redesign focused on colour scheme and imagery • Seamless mobile/desktop experience, fully tested across common browsers • Basic on-page SEO refresh to restore lost visibility
If you have experience blending sophisticated aesthetics with solid technical execution, I’d love to see your approach and a few relevant examples.

item.title: Build My WooCommerce Storefront
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to turn my idea into a fully-functioning e-commerce shop and need a WooCommerce pro who can handle both design flair and solid technical setup. The end goal is a polished storefront that looks great on any device and runs smoothly behind the scenes.
Here’s what I have in mind: a clean, conversion-focused design built directly in WordPress + WooCommerce, complete with payment gateway integration, a customer product-review section, and inventory management that keeps stock levels accurate without extra manual work. I’d like the theme customised to match my branding, pages laid out for easy navigation, and checkout streamlined so shoppers can move from cart to confirmation in as few clicks as possible.
Key deliverables • Customised WooCommerce theme and responsive page layouts • Fully configured payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal or similar) and test transactions completed • Product review system styled to match the site and ready for moderation • Inventory management set up with automatic stock updates and low-stock alerts • Core plugins and security settings optimised for speed, SEO and data protection • Final walk-through plus hand-off of admin documentation
If you’ve launched stores before, know your way around CSS/PHP tweaks, and can keep communication clear and timely, I’d love to start right away.

item.title: Shopify 2.0 Theme Development Expert Needed
item.description:
250-750 USD | I am looking for Shopify expert.
The site is already fully designed for mobile and desktop, with final copy. We will provide an HTML/CSS/JS export and a live preview link. We need it built as a fast, lean Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme, connected to our apps, and maintained after launch. No design, copy or strategy work.
Scope summary (full brief attached): - Pixel-accurate OS 2.0 theme from our design, editable sections, content in HTML - About 10 pages plus a simple blog, a batch-lookup page and 1 to 2 landing templates - Shopify Payments, Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay - Appstle subscriptions (monthly, 15% off, styled widget and customer portal) - Klaviyo, Okendo, Gorgias, post-purchase survey, ShiptQuick 3PL sync - Meta, Google, Reddit and TikTok tracking via official apps, GA4 - SEO basics, Merchant Center feed, robots.txt open to search and AI crawlers - Must pass mobile Core Web Vitals and WCAG 2.1 AA
Target: live and QA'd by end of November.
Most Important: Ideal candidate is who worked on Osavi or Saltt. If you are worked at those companies, I will hire you immediately.
Please send a fixed price, a timeline, and an optional monthly maintenance retainer.

item.title: Classic Shopify Store Design
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I run a camcorder-rental business that is expanding into direct sales of gear and companion digital downloads such as LUT packs and training files. I’m looking for a Shopify specialist who can translate that mix into a classic, elegant storefront that evokes trust and professionalism while staying easy to navigate on any device.
The site’s primary job is twofold: first, to showcase and schedule rentals of my physical cameras and accessories; second, to let customers instantly purchase both physical add-ons and digital products from the same cart. I’d like the design to feel timeless—think clean typography, balanced white space, and refined product photography—without losing any of Shopify’s modern conveniences.
Key deliverables • A custom, responsive Shopify theme styled in a classic, elegant aesthetic • Rental workflow configured (calendar/booking app, deposit handling, blackout dates, automated reminders) • Standard e-commerce flow for physical products plus digital-download fulfillment (instant file delivery) • Home, collection, product, about, FAQ and contact pages fully built and populated with sample content I’ll supply • Payment, tax and shipping rules set up, with test transactions confirming everything works end-to-end • Basic SEO settings, speed optimization and a short hand-over guide so I can add new products myself
Acceptance criteria – Pages load in under 3 seconds on mobile according to Shopify’s analyzer – Test rental, physical and digital orders each complete without errors – Visual style matches the classic/elegant reference sites I’ll share at kickoff
All assets (logo, images, copy) will be provided once we start; I simply need your design and Shopify expertise to bring the storefront to life.

item.title: Build My Payhip Digital Store
item.description:
20-250 GBP | I have a Payhip account that already hosts my products, but I want a stand-alone e-commerce website that feels branded, polished and fully under my own domain. All items in the catalogue are digital passes, so the site must be optimised for instant delivery after purchase and integrate smoothly with Payhip’s payment and fulfilment APIs.
Here’s the flow I’m envisioning: a clean home page that introduces the offer, product pages generated from the existing Payhip listings, a simple checkout that still uses Payhip for payment processing, and an automatic redirect or email with the pass once the transaction is successful. The design should be responsive, lightweight and easy for me to update later without touching code—think WordPress + WooCommerce, Webflow, or any modern builder you’re comfortable with as long as it plays nicely with Payhip’s embeddable buttons or API.
Acceptance criteria: • Branded theme applied, matching my current colours and logo • All current digital passes imported or embedded from Payhip • Seamless checkout with instant download or access delivery • Basic SEO set-up (titles, meta descriptions, sitemap) • Quick walkthrough or video showing me how to add new passes in the future
If this sounds straightforward to you, let’s get it live.

item.title: Full Stack Web Developer / Figma Sites Expert - Consumer Brand Website + more potential projects
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | Our client needs a fast & responsive website that serves as an information hub for a consumer brand. At its core will be a regularly-updated blog, supported by a prominent contact form and a section for client testimonials to reinforce credibility. The look and feel should be modern, fast-loading and equally comfortable on mobile and desktop.
We have a designer/motion artist on staff who will create the UI/UX + all design materials needed.
Looking for a 2-5 years experience in website development.
Must be able to create a website that is hosted on one of the following: - WordPress - SquareSpace - Framer - Wix Studio - Figma Sites - Webflow
This project specifically will be hosted on Figma Sites, with design being done in Figma. Ideally this will be a shorter, easier, and faster implementation process given the nature of the platform.
You will handle the full stack: database setup, back-end logic and a straightforward content management workflow so we can publish new posts without touching code. For future projects, whether you prefer React with a Node/Express API, a Django stack, or WordPress with custom blocks, I’m open to the approach as long as it delivers security, ease of maintenance and solid SEO fundamentals.
Key deliverables • Fully designed and coded website with blog, contact form and testimonial carousel/display, among other requirements. Estimated 10 pages total. • Simple admin interface for adding posts, editing pages and approving testimonials • Deployed to client's hosting with SSL configured and basic on-page SEO in place • Brief hand-over guide (video or PDF) so the client can manage content independently
Acceptance criteria • Pages load under three seconds on 4G per Google Lighthouse • Contact form successfully sends to my designated email and stores entries in the database • Blog post creation, editing and deletion work from the admin panel without errors • Testimonials display accurately and can be reordered from the back end
Send a short outline of the tech stack you propose, any sites you have built and an estimated timeline for design, development and deployment. Bonus points if you've used Figma Sties

item.title: Functional E-commerce Website Development
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I’m ready to launch an online store that sells physical goods and need a developer who can take the idea from concept to a fully functioning e-commerce site. The core of the build must cover a clean product catalogue, fast product search and filtering, and a reliable shopping-cart / checkout flow.
Here is what I expect: • A modern, responsive storefront populated with a sample set of products so I can see the flow end-to-end. • Intuitive search and filter tools that help shoppers narrow results by category, price and any other key attributes you recommend. • A secure cart and checkout pipeline that supports credit-card and PayPal payments out of the box, with room to add local gateways later. • Basic admin dashboard for inventory, order tracking and coupon management. • SEO-friendly structure and speed optimisation so pages load quickly on mobile.
Nice-to-have items such as user reviews can remain optional for now; I’m open to your advice on the best timing and plugin choices. Please outline the platform or stack you prefer (Shopify, WooCommerce, custom React + headless, etc.) and any themes or extensions you’d suggest to stay within a scalable architecture.
When you respond, let me know: 1. A live link to one comparable store you’ve built. 2. Which e-commerce platform you think suits selling physical goods in the long run and why. 3. A rough delivery timeline for a working MVP that includes search/filter and cart.
I’m keen to start as soon as we agree on the approach, so share your plan and let’s get this store online.

item.title: Australian Shopify Store Setup Needed
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I’m launching a brand-new Shopify store that will sell 100% digital products—think downloadable templates, guides and similar items. Because the entire offer is virtual, I need someone who not only knows Shopify inside out but is also certified here in Australia so everything from GST to local payment gateways is configured correctly.
Here’s the vision: the storefront should feel bold and colourful, instantly telling visitors they’re in the right place for creative digital goods. I’d like you to recommend or customise a theme that captures that vibe, fine-tune the colour palette and typography, and make sure the layout looks great on desktop and mobile.
I do need hands-on help creating the product listings themselves. That includes setting up digital file delivery, writing concise yet persuasive descriptions, adding eye-catching graphics, and configuring any licence or download-limit settings that Shopify allows. If you have a proven workflow for bulk-uploading or templating listings, all the better.
Key deliverables • Full Shopify store setup (domains, payments, taxes, digital-delivery settings) • Theme selection or customisation to achieve a bold, colourful aesthetic • Creation and upload of initial digital product listings with thumbnails, descriptions and file attachments • Basic on-page SEO and navigation structure so shoppers can find products quickly • Handover notes that show me how to add future digital products on my own
I’m ready to get started as soon as I find the right certified Aussie expert who can tick these boxes and communicate promptly in our time zone. If that sounds like you, let’s chat.

item.title: Shopify Store Setup
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I need a Shopify store set up to sell both physical and digital products. I have a specific theme in mind and do not require any customizations.
Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proficiency in Shopify - Experience with theme implementation - Familiarity with setting up stores for both physical and digital products

item.title: Finalize Toast POS Website
item.description:
30-250 USD | My restaurant’s site is already connected to Toast, but it isn’t quite ready for public launch or online ordering. I need a developer who works with Toast every day—front-end and back-end—who is based in the U.S. and communicates clearly in English.
Our current website is currently running via "popmenu" and I would like it to be closely mirror with some visual and new updates.
The remaining work breaks down into two areas:
• Menu setup inside Toast: add several new dishes, update the existing items with current pricing and descriptions, and reorganize categories so guests can browse intuitively. • Website completion: refine the design to match our brand, squash the lingering layout and responsiveness bugs, and refresh a handful of text/image sections so everything looks polished and consistent.
I’ll give you direct access to the Toast admin, current site repo, style guide, and a short punch-list of visual tweaks. Success means the menu renders perfectly on both desktop and mobile, checkout flows without errors, and the site is stable enough to flip the “Go Live” switch. If you’ve launched other Toast-powered sites and can start right away, let’s talk today.

item.title: Engaging Adventure Campaign Website Design
item.description:
250-750 AUD | Create a quality, engaging website design for my project, inviting people to apply for a paid adventure showcasing work and life in regional Australia.
The website will be the central destination for campaign information, paid entries, applicant video uploads and social media content. It should be easy to use on a mobile phone and simple for the campaign team to manage.
Core website content:
A compact but stylish website with the following pages or sections -
Home: strong campaign imagery or video, a short explanation and a prominent “Enter Now” button.
How it works: the opportunity, entry requirements, selection process, key dates and frequently asked questions.
Enter: application form, video upload and secure payment.
Follow the adventure: campaign videos, social media highlights and updates.
Partners: approved sponsor logos, links and a partnership enquiry option.
Contact and policies: contact details, entry terms, privacy policy and refund policy. Entry and payment process
Applicants must be able to complete the process on their phone.
Enter their name, age, email, country of residence, relevant eligibility details and optional social media handles.
Upload a short application video.
Accept the entry terms and provide consent for the proposed use of their video.
Marketing subscription should be a separate, optional choice.
Pay the entry fee through a secure hosted checkout.
Receive an on-screen confirmation and email receipt with a unique entry reference.
The entry fee and currency must be clearly displayed before payment and editable by the campaign administrator. Support international applicants and payment cards.
Each payment must be linked to the correct application and video. An entry is complete only when both the video upload and payment are confirmed. Applicants must be able to retry an interrupted upload or payment without being charged twice.
Video uploads: Allow direct uploads from a phone or computer.
Support common phone video formats, including MP4 and MOV.
*Designs need to be provided for both website and phone/tablet.
Clearly show the permitted video length and file size before uploading.
Display upload progress, successful completion and clear error messages. Store videos securely, with access restricted to authorised campaign staff.
Allow administrators to watch, review and shortlist submissions.
Publish applicant videos only after approval and with the required consent.
Social media integration: Include prominent links to the campaign’s Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube accounts, plus sharing buttons and the campaign hashtag. Allow the team to feature selected social posts and videos using supported embeds, with linked thumbnails as a fallback. Updating featured content should be straightforward. Social content should load without slowing down the entry process.
Administration: Provide a password-protected dashboard where the campaign team can: -View and search entries, videos and payment status. -Mark applications as reviewed or shortlisted. -Export applicant information and payment references. -Update copy, dates, FAQs, sponsor logos and featured content.
Open and close entries. Manage retention and deletion of applicant information. Design and delivery The visual style should be bold, welcoming and distinctly Australian, reflecting regional work, travel and adventure. Use existing 88 Days and Rockt branding. The site must be accessible, fast on mobile connections and able to accommodate traffic spikes from media coverage. Include basic analytics for visits, entry starts, completed entries and referrals from social campaigns.
Developer proposal Please provide a fixed-price quote, delivery schedule and handover training. Itemise ongoing hosting, video storage, payment processing, maintenance and any social media integration costs. Explain how costs will change as entries and video views increase.

item.title: Insert Text in WordPress Policy
item.description:
30-250 USD | My WordPress site’s privacy policy needs a tiny tweak: I have one short paragraph ready to go, and I want it placed in the middle of the existing policy page. No rewriting, no extra styling—simply paste the text exactly as provided so it inherits the current formatting.
You’ll receive the login credentials and the exact paragraph once we start. After the update, send back a quick confirmation or screenshot so I can double-check the change. It’s a single-page edit, so if you’re familiar with WordPress pages or the block editor, this should be a fast, clean task.

item.title: Rustic Nautical Shopify Theme
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m building an online store for boat-detailing supplies and need a custom Shopify theme that captures the look and feel of a sport-fisherman’s transom—exactly like the logo file I’ve attached. The overall vibe must read rustic and nautical, with weathered textures, rope or teak accents, and ocean-inspired typography that complements the logo.
Homepage vision The first screen should be a full-width hero banner where I’ll rotate lifestyle shots of big offshore boats. Beneath that, I want easily editable sections for featured collections, new arrivals, and optionally an Instagram feed. I’ll handle all products, pricing, and copy once the layout is finished, so your focus is on design, theme settings, and a smooth, responsive structure.
Technical expectations • Built on Shopify’s latest Online Store 2.0 framework so I get section-everywhere flexibility, fast load times, and theme-editor control. • Theme packaged as a ready-to-upload .zip, with any custom sections clearly documented. • Color palette is open as long as it pairs well with the nautical imagery and maintains the rustic tone. Feel free to suggest options.
Acceptance criteria • Logo placed prominently in the header, styled to match the transom aesthetic. • Full-width hero configurable from the theme editor. • Clean, mobile-first code and cross-browser testing. • Staging link provided for review before final hand-off.
Once the design and structure are locked, I’ll take it from there. Share your approach and timeline so we can get this ship launched. I will set up my domain on Shopify as well. Thanks for the help!

item.title: Finish WooCommerce Store Today
item.description:
30-250 USD | My WooCommerce store is roughly 80 % complete and I need it fully operational within the next 24 hours. The site already has the theme, core pages, and most styling in place; what’s left are three critical pieces that must work flawlessly before we go live:
• Payment gateway integration – connect and test a single gateway (Stripe preferred, PayPal acceptable) so payments flow through to the order-received page and confirm in the WooCommerce dashboard. • Product listing – upload the remaining products (about 20 SKUs), assign images, prices, variations, and be sure categories filter correctly. • Checkout process – verify cart, coupons, shipping, taxes, and guest/customer checkout all complete without errors on both desktop and mobile.
I’ll give you WordPress admin, FTP, and gateway credentials immediately. The finished site should let me place a live test order from start to finish without glitches, show orders in the back-end, and send the customer and admin emails that WooCommerce normally fires.
Acceptance criteria 1. Payment gateway shows “Success” on a live test transaction. 2. All products display with correct pricing, stock status, and thumbnails. 3. Cart → Checkout → Thank-you page flow works on Chrome, Safari, and mobile. 4. No console errors or PHP warnings in debug mode. 5. Delivery is completed within the agreed 24-hour window.
If you’re comfortable jumping straight into a WordPress/WooCommerce stack and wrapping up these last pieces today, let’s get started.

item.title: Shopify Product Listings Setup Support
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m launching a new Shopify store that will initially feature a small line of business-card holders and cell-phone holders. My account is already open, the theme is installed, and I have both images and copy ready to go—I simply need an experienced Shopify hand to turn those assets into polished, sales-ready product pages.
Scope • Upload and configure 1–10 products in the Shopify admin. • Enter my provided titles, descriptions, pricing and inventory numbers. • Optimise every image for fast load times and add ALT text for SEO. • Assign each item to the correct collections, tags and menu paths so navigation is tidy from day one. • Confirm that each listing displays correctly on both desktop and mobile and is connected to the existing checkout flow.
Acceptance A quick walkthrough via collaborator access or screen-share once the pages are live will close the project; I should see every listing published, searchable on-site and ready to accept payments.
If you know Shopify inside out and can complete this task smoothly, let’s get it done.

item.title: Enhance UX for Beauty Industry Platform
item.description:
30-250 AUD | CoWorkz is a business operating system for the beauty industry: independent beauty professionals, salons, hybrid salons (employees plus rented chairs), shared-workspace / co-working operators, and the professionals who rent from them. It handles bookings, clients, content creation, payments and an AI assistant called Abby. The same codebase also runs The Beauty Basement, my own shared salon workspace in Perth, which is one customer-type example, not the identity of every member. The product has a very large feature surface that was built fast, largely with AI coding agents. It mostly works, but the UX is inconsistent, several workflows dead-end or over-promise, and the visual polish is not at the level a paying customer expects. I need a senior front-end/full-stack engineer with real product-design instinct to stabilise it, finish the core workflows properly, and get it to a state I can confidently sell and support.
The goal is not new features. It is: every core screen looks right, every core button does what it says, on desktop and phone.

item.title: Eco Laundry Site Revamp & Ads
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | Blue Sky Eco Laundry needs the contact-and-ordering section of our website completely refreshed. The goal is to give customers a smooth, attractive multi-step checkout that lets them schedule pickups, choose wash-and-fold options, review pricing, and pay securely—then funnels the order straight into our backend for effortless processing.
Here’s what has to happen: • Redesign the user interface of the contact and ordering module so it looks modern, loads fast on mobile, and guides users step-by-step. • Rebuild the order-processing logic so incoming orders trigger the right email/SMS confirmations and appear in an easy-to-manage dashboard for staff. • Integrate the new flow with Stripe or a similar gateway, keeping security and PCI compliance in mind. • Launch and manage Google Ads campaigns targeting local laundry keywords, write compelling ad copy, set up conversion tracking, and optimise regularly to improve ROI.
Preference will be given to freelancers who have prior experience working with wash-and-fold delivery laundromats.
If you can also bolt on a simple customer-feedback add-on later, that flexibility will be a bonus. The work is finished when customers can place a wash-and-fold order in minutes, the order shows up flawlessly in our system, and the ad dashboard proves those clicks are turning into sales.

item.title: Design & Implement Secure Online Members Area -- 2
item.description:
250-750 GBP | Brief for potential digital designers - S.G. Leads online members area
We are a UK based charity looking for the best quotes and turn around time for designing and implementing a new members only area, connected to our existing website.
Included in the quote, we want to know about: Upfront fee/hourly fee (if hourly, give approx. time it will take) Ongoing/annual costs for running it / any plug ins etc
We would want an idea of how you would expect this to look based on our specifications.
Project summary:
We are a UK based charity looking for quotes on creating an members only area which would be connected to our existing website. Members would have their own secure login. When in the members area, there would be a section that only the member and the admin can see : their registration documents, their groups database and information, training progress etc. There would also be a second area which would be a “communal area” for the members with access to all members. This “communal area” would have: - updates from the admin team/charity. - Training opportunities, guidance and resources - Events Calendar - Book a 30 minute call with a specific person in the charity - Report a safeguarding concern
This new members area must be in line with our existing Branding and communications guide. It must be designed with accessibility, welcome, friendliness and positivity in mind. It must be secure.

item.title:
We are seeking an experienced website developer, branding specialist, or full-service digital marketing agency to assist with the launch of a licensed adult-use cannabis retail dispensary in New Jersey.
Our objective is to establish a professional, recog
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | Scope of Work
1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop a professional, modern, mobile-responsive dispensary website.
Create pages including Home, About Us, Products, Promotions, FAQs, Careers, and Contact.
Integrate an age-verification gateway.
Incorporate online product browsing and ordering functionality.
Evaluate integration with Sweed POS and other compatible cannabis retail platforms.
Include store hours, location, directions, and contact information.
Implement search engine optimization (SEO) fundamentals.
Provide website hosting, security, maintenance, and administrative access options.
Ensure website functionality supports applicable New Jersey cannabis advertising and retail requirements.
2. Branding & Corporate Identity
Develop or refine the company's brand identity.
Design a professional logo and alternative logo variations.
Recommend brand colors, typography, and visual guidelines.
Create a comprehensive brand style guide.
Develop branded graphics for digital and print marketing.
Provide concepts for promotional materials, merchandise, and retail signage.
Establish consistent brand messaging and positioning.
3. Social Media & Digital Marketing
Develop a pre-opening and grand-opening marketing strategy.

Moreover, we are a small travel company near Frankfurt, Germany. Our website, frankenbridge.com, sells small-group local tours to travelers from the US, Canada and Latin America. It runs on WordPress, Elementor and TranslatePress (5 languages). Bookings run through Bókun, a third-party booking widget.
THE PROBLEM Google shows too few of our pages. Search Console, Oct 7, 2026: - 1,680 pages indexed, 914 not indexed - About 485 are the real problem: 278 "discovered, not indexed", 117 "duplicate, different canonical", 90 "crawled, not indexed" - Known pages grew from about 500 to 2,600 after we added language versions - 509 clicks in 3 months, almost all from people who already search our brand name We want travelers to find us by searching for tours, not for our name.
Second problem: purchase events from the Bókun checkout (an iframe) do not reach GA4, so we cannot measure bookings.
WHAT WE WANT Phase 1 (this project): a paid audit. No changes to the live site. You deliver a written report with a ranked fix list and a time estimate for each fix. Phase 2 (later, same person if the audit is good): fix indexing, hreflang, canonicals, titles and descriptions, and GSC / GA4 / GTM tracking. YOU MUST HAVE - Technical SEO on WordPress (indexing, canonicals, hreflang, sitemaps) - Google Search Console, GA4 and Google Tag Manager - Experience with multilingual sites (TranslatePress or similar) - Clear written English
HOW WE WORK - Freelancer.com milestones only. No payments, chats or call links (Teams, Zoom) outside the platform. - Google tools by email invitation. We never share passwords. - WordPress at Editor level. Administrator only for one task, with an end date, after a backup. - Backup first. Written reports.
HOW TO APPLY We read every bid. Bids that skip these steps are ignored. Start your bid with the word FRANKFURT. Then answer: 1. List the top 3 causes of "crawled, not indexed" and how you would check each one. 2. How would you get purchase events from a third-party booking iframe into GA4? 3. Link one site whose search traffic you grew, and tell us what you did. 4. Give your fixed price for the Phase 1 audit and how many days it takes.

item.description:

item.title: Shopify Website Development for Muse Club London
item.description:
2-8 USD/hr | Hi! I’m looking for a freelancer to design and build a complete Shopify website for my new brand, Muse Club London.

I also want the Shopify store to be easy for me to manage afterwards so I can add new products, change pictures and prices, create discount codes and update the website myself.
Please let me know your price, how long it would take, what is included in your service and what you need from me to get started.
Thank you!
Muse Club London
